notes.title: Update 1.26.7 is now live on all platforms
notes.notes:
Update 1.26.7 brings several key improvements to Way of the Hunter. PC players can now enjoy FSR2 and DLSS presets for better visual quality and performance. Multiplayer features a location ping system, join and leave notifications, and an upgraded server browser with map details and difficulty levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/9a65f15c1fe4f8eb2e159f6c295432a7a3db3654.jpg[/img]

We’ve also improved the herd management info on the hunting map, made the encyclopedia more user-friendly, and refined HUDless mode for a more immersive experience. Additionally, we’ve fixed several bugs, including shotgun reload issues, audio glitches, and floating trees in Transylvania - for more details, please check the patch notes below.

[h3]Enhanced Hunting Map UI 
[/h3]With this update, we're introducing an enhanced Hunting Map UI, providing clearer insights into animal herds, their habitats, and the impact of your hunting activities. This update makes herd management more accessible by allowing players to track herd fitness over time and see how their hunting choices affect populations. Previously, manual note-taking was required, but now, after each in-game year, you can easily view herd fitness levels on the map, helping to refine your strategy for more effective and sustainable management. For detailed info on this feature, we’ve prepared a full breakdown [url=https://ninerocksgames.com/posts/update-1-26-7-strategic-habitat-management-and-herd-fitness]HERE[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/bdc5ea9d847a37ce97cbb52f205db4816cebe760.png[/img]

notes.title: Community Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Hunters!

First, we want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1288320/eventcomments/595137443379859674/]end-of-year survey[/url] featured in the latest [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1288320/eventcomments/601891059815966979/]Hunter Log[/url]. Your enthusiasm and passion for Way of the Hunter have inspired us.

We received a great turnout, with thousands of responses pouring in! Initially, when we planned to close the survey, we noticed many of you still hadn’t had the chance to participate. So, we extended it and sent out reminders, leading to an even greater turnout. The feedback we’ve gathered so far is highly valuable to our team.

Here’s a sneak peek at some early survey insights we’d like to share with you:

While we originally hoped to share more details by tomorrow, we need a bit more time to fully prepare and evaluate your feedback. Thank you for being part of this journey. Your input is shaping the future of Way of the Hunter, and we’re committed to delivering experiences that also reflect a lot of what matters most to you, our core community members.

Thank you for your patience, stay tuned!
